name: Jharkhand - Jharia coalfield
story: One of India's largest coalfields; open-cast pit expansion and overburden dumps enlarge bare land at the expense of vegetation and settlements.

products.title: Forest loss
products.description: Tree cover replaced by fields, bare land or construction.

products.title: New water
products.description: Land became permanent water (reservoirs, subsidence pools).

products.title: Water loss
products.description: Water bodies replaced by land (drying, infilling, mining cut).
